observations: A physically blinded one-response trial can be completed without persisting seed or expected values by keeping them only in a live scorer process and committing the public request first.
The existing invariant evaluator is lexically brittle: instruction wording verification is not accepted by a scorer requiring the literal substring verify.
Because the mismatch was observed only after the locked output, repairing it inside this trial would invalidate the precommitment; it belongs in a later falsifiable unit.
